content.json:
# Security Posture Dashboard

Microsoft Defender for Cloud Secure Score, active recommendations, and alert trends for the Azure platform.

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize AlertCount = count() by Severity = AlertSeverity, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Security Alerts (Last 7 Days) by Severity

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where AlertSeverity in ('High', 'Critical')
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, CompromisedEntity, RemediationSteps, Status
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Critical & High Alerts (Last 24 Hours)

content.query:
SecurityRecommendation
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where RecommendationState == 'Active'
| summarize count() by RecommendationSeverity
| project Severity = RecommendationSeverity, Count = count_
content.title: Active Recommendations by Severity

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where OperationNameValue contains 'DELETE' and ActivityStatusValue == 'Success'
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, OperationNameValue, ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Resource Deletions (Last 24 Hours)
